intro.headingSoft: We apply the same discipline to every project — from pouring the foundation to fitting the last switch plate.
intro.tagLabel: The philosophy behind every Ligne Verticale site

services.heading: What we build
services.subtitle: Five services, one team — from the first sketch to the last coat of paint.

constructii.title: New construction
constructii.copy: We raise houses and buildings from the foundation to the roof, with solid structures and flawless execution.

renovari.title: Full renovations
renovari.copy: We turn tired, outdated spaces into modern, energy-efficient homes full of personality.

amenajari.title: Interior design
amenajari.copy: We design and fit out interiors that balance everyday function with refined aesthetics.

curatare.title: Pressure washing
curatare.copy: We clean façades, terraces, driveways and roofs with professional pressure-washing equipment, without damaging the surfaces.

consultanta.title: Consulting & design
consultanta.copy: We guide you from the first sketch to the final technical plan, with solutions built around your budget.

footer.tagline: Construction and renovation with architectural precision — homes, interiors and commercial spaces, built to last.
footer.madeWith: Built with care for every detail.

hero.heading: We've been building for over 15 years, with the same obsession for detail.
hero.subtitle: Ligne Verticale started with a small team of engineers and architects who believed a well-run site shows in every line of the finished building. Today we run residential and commercial projects nationwide, with the same attention to detail from the first sketch to the last key handed over.

values.heading: What guides us on site
values.subtitle: Four principles we don't compromise on, whatever the size of the project.

precizie.title: Precision
precizie.copy: Every measurement and every joint matters. We double-check what others check once.

transparenta.title: Transparency
transparenta.copy: Clear budgets, realistic timelines, and steady site reports — no surprises at the end of the job.

sustenabilitate.title: Sustainability
sustenabilitate.copy: We choose materials and energy solutions that cut long-term costs, not just costs on paper.

parteneriat.title: Long-term partnership
parteneriat.copy: We stay by our clients' side after handover too, for maintenance and future extensions.

process.heading: How we work
process.subtitle: Four stages, one project manager from the first phone call to final handover.

consultanta.title: Consultation
consultanta.copy: We talk about the site, the budget and your vision, and set a realistic plan from the first meeting.

proiectare.title: Design
proiectare.copy: Our architects turn the idea into a complete technical project, approved and ready for construction.

executie.title: Execution
executie.copy: Our site teams work to schedule, with quality checks at every stage of the job.

predare.title: Handover & maintenance
predare.copy: We hand over a turnkey project and stay available for warranty, service and maintenance.

departments.heading: The team behind every site
departments.subtitle: Four departments working in sync, so no detail is left to chance.

arhitectura.title: Architecture & Design
arhitectura.copy: Turns ideas into clear plans, with spatial solutions suited to each site and budget.

inginerie.title: Structural engineering
inginerie.copy: Calculates and verifies every structure, from the foundation to the last roof element.

executie.title: Site execution
executie.copy: Experienced foremen and crews, on site every day, coordinated by a single lead.

management.title: Project management
management.copy: Coordinates timelines, suppliers and budgets, from signing the contract to final handover.
